decision.summary: No confirmed temporary offsets: the prolonged E/U descent (500–664) lacks a return; the sharp multi-axis event at ~685–689 stabilizes at a new level with no opposing return observed before index 699. Both intervals are uncertain due to missing return evidence within allowed context.

intervals.observation: E-component shows sustained monotonic descent from ~−2.5 to ~−13 MAD over indices 500–664; U-component also declines steadily with superposed fluctuations; no opposing return observed within allowed context. N remains stable. This lacks a return phase, so cannot be classified as a temporary offset.

Multi-axis displacement at index ~685: sharp U-jump (~+10 MAD), E-dip (~−11 MAD), and delayed N-rise (~+26 MAD); post-event values stabilize at new plateau without reversal by index 699. Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 699).
